name: indie Semiconductor, Inc.
summary: indie Semiconductor, Inc. provides automotive semiconductors and software solutions for advanced driver assistance systems, autonomous vehicles, connected car, user experience, and electrification applications. It designs, develops, manufactures, and markets integrated circuits. The company also offers mixed-signal system-on-chips (SoCs) and system solutions for advanced driver assistance systems.
